slabs_guarded_against_falling.rule_code: Slabs must be Guarded against Falling
slabs_guarded_against_falling.question: What slabs in the current IFC model are not guarded against falling (missing barriers or acceptable drop to landing)?
slabs_guarded_against_falling.rule:
Slabs must be Guarded against Falling
This rule checks that it is not possible to fall from slabs. The rule checks that horizontal components are surrounded by vertical components, such as walls or railings. If no vertical component exists on the edge of a horizontal component, another horizontal component or stairs needs to continue and the drop to the other horizontal component must not be more than specified.
slabs_guarded_against_falling.parameters: Include Slab Building Elements - General: One Of [Balconies, Floor Slabs]. Barrier Components: Include Wall, Railing, Object, Column, Stair. Min barrier total height 1 m; max horizontal or vertical gap between barriers 0.1 m; max horizontal or vertical gap from platform to barriers 0.1 m. Fall and Landing: Include Slab, Site, Stair, Ramp. Max distance to landing 0.1 m; max fall 0.5 m; min landing width 0.2 m. Barrier height and climbable: distance to top of barrier (longest reach) 1 m; height of climb (unclimbable above) 0.6 m; side width (min foothold) 0.15 m. Barrier height measured from top of climbable curb: False
